threats.title: Private assessment bearer capability leakage
threats.attack: Capability appears in URL, client-readable storage, logs, analytics, or public share output.
threats.impact: Unauthorized access to private diagnostic result or destructive owner actions.
mitigations: private token absent from URLs/public snapshots
threats.residual: Browser/device compromise remains outside application guarantees.

threats.title: Public share capability enumeration
threats.attack: Attacker guesses or enumerates public share URLs.
threats.impact: Unauthorized discovery of intentionally shared but capability-scoped result pages.
threats.residual: Anyone possessing a valid share URL can view that intentionally public snapshot.

threats.title: Cross-site mutation of answers/shares/deletion
threats.attack: Third-party site causes authenticated browser to save/complete/share/revoke/delete.
threats.impact: Result corruption, unwanted publication, or deletion.
threats.residual: Compromised same-origin script remains an application/XSS concern.

threats.title: Spoofed forwarded client IP defeats IP rate-limit principal
threats.attack: Client supplies forwarded headers that application mistakes for trusted edge metadata.
threats.impact: Assessment-session creation rate-limit bypass or bucket manipulation.
threats.residual: Repository cannot prove the deployed edge overwrites the selected header.

threats.title: Raw diagnostic data leaks through analytics/telemetry
threats.attack: Answer values, full Trait vector, Extended Code, prose or bearer capabilities are added to telemetry.
threats.impact: Creation of an unintended diagnostic dataset or third-party exposure.
threats.residual: Production log/hosting provider enrichment still needs deployed review.

threats.title: Private diagnostic fields enter public share snapshot
threats.attack: Share export accidentally includes raw answers, Trait Scores, Extended Code, response quality or private IDs.
threats.impact: Sensitive diagnostic disclosure to anyone with public share URL.
mitigations: public page reads sanitized table only
threats.residual: Future share-schema changes must preserve the sanitizer/DB guard.

threats.title: Published diagnostic history is silently rewritten
threats.attack: Existing published item/model/content/result rows are updated in place.
threats.impact: Historical results become irreproducible or change meaning without version evidence.
threats.residual: Actual production admin/migration role separation still requires deployment evidence.

threats.title: Runtime database credential can perform DDL/admin changes
threats.attack: Compromised app runtime uses overly privileged DB credential to alter schema/versioned definitions.
threats.impact: Data/model integrity loss and broader compromise.
mitigations: CI restricted PostgreSQL role proves representative DML without DDL/definition writes
threats.residual: Actual production role identity/grants and migration-admin separation are not repository-provable.

threats.title: Restore resurrects later-deleted diagnostic/share data
threats.attack: Older backup is restored after user deletion/revocation and public traffic resumes without deletion replay.
threats.impact: Deleted private data or revoked public share becomes available again.
threats.residual: Independently durable deletion journal/equivalent and provider-level rehearsal are not yet implemented/proven.

threats.title: Exception/request objects expose diagnostics or capabilities in logs
threats.attack: Unexpected Error/request/token/result object is serialized by console logging.
threats.impact: Bearer capability or diagnostic data enters operational log storage.
mitigations: runtime direct console.error bypass prohibited by CI
threats.residual: Hosting/log provider retention/access/enrichment must be reviewed in production.

threats.title: Known vulnerable or tampered production dependency
threats.attack: Build consumes vulnerable dependency or unreviewed drift.
threats.residual: Registry/account compromise and zero-day risk remain operational concerns.

threats.title: Secrets or AI credentials enter repository/client artifact
threats.attack: Secret is committed, advertised through public env, or bundled into browser artifact.
threats.impact: Credential compromise or unreviewed runtime data export.
threats.residual: Actual production secret store/access/rotation remains external.

threats.title: Runtime generative service changes diagnostic/result behavior or exports data
threats.attack: Production code introduces LLM/image API dependency or sends diagnostic data to a generative service.
threats.impact: Non-reproducible output, privacy export, secret requirement and model drift.
threats.residual: Future dependency/code changes remain subject to CI governance.

threats.title: Pre-launch/beta routes become indexed unintentionally
threats.attack: Deployment exposes development model pages to search indexing before launch approval.
threats.residual: Actual deployed crawler/CDN behavior must be observed.

threats.title: Ordinary product analytics becomes calibration research data without consent
threats.attack: Existing events/results are exported/reused for psychometric analysis without explicit governance.
threats.impact: Privacy/consent violation and invalid evidence lineage.
threats.residual: Implementation stays intentionally blocked until prerequisites exist.

threats.title: Packaged application runs as root
threats.attack: Application compromise inherits unnecessary OS privilege.
